font_note: Neither selected asset repository includes Segoe UI fonts. No font was downloaded.

unavailable.taskmanager: Selected repositories do not contain a verified Vista Task Manager icon. WindowsTask.png is the older CRT Task Manager artwork and was deliberately not exported as taskmanager. The available Fandom Vista/7 source could be read as a page but its image was inaccessible.
unavailable.font: Segoe UI is absent from both selected repositories.
unavailable.forest: No verified native Vista forest sample photo was downloadable from selected sources. The native Vista lake and landscape wallpapers are included instead.
unavailable.terminal: The verified Vista-labelled PNGEgg image URL served an opaque checkerboard preview, so it was not exported. The other candidate is explicitly labelled Windows XP in the source metadata and was not substituted.
